title: Towards an approach to multivariate outlier detection for District Heating System data
abstract: arXiv:2608.11375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we test different methods for multivariate detection of outliers in the data of transmitted heat energy in the selected substation of local District Heating System, by also considering outside ambient temperature, namely Z-score (univariate, as a benchmark), Mahalanobis distances, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Isolation Forest and Hotelling's T-squared test. The overall research aims at uncovering irregular plant operation, with a wider objective of identifying the opportunities for reducing the consumption of gas in central heating plants as well as the CO2 emission. The proposed approach considers specific domain circumstances, such as irrelevance of zero transmit-ted energy timepoints as indication of off-grid plant. translated_title: 面向区域供热系统数据的多变量异常检测方法探索
translated_abstract: 本文针对本地区域供热系统选定子站传输热能数据，结合外部环境温度，测试了多种多变量异常检测方法，包括Z-score（单变量，作为基准）、马氏距离、主成分分析（PCA）、孤立森林和Hotelling T-squared检验。总体研究旨在发现异常工厂运行，更广泛的目标是识别减少中央供暖厂燃气消耗和CO2排放的机会。所提方法考虑了特定领域情况，如零传输能量时间点作为离网工厂指示的不相关性。不同方法的结果与领域专家进行了讨论。结论是PCA、孤立森林和Hotelling方法提供了相关结果。最后，我们采用了集成方法。
tldr: 本文通过比较多种多变量异常检测方法，并考虑领域特定条件，提出了一种集成方法，用于识别区域供热系统中的异常运行，以促进节能和减排。
en_tdlr: This paper compares multivariate outlier detection methods, considering domain-specific conditions, and proposes an ensemble approach to identify irregular operations in district heating systems for energy saving and emission reduction.
